source.title: Towards a common reporting framework for AI incidents
source.table: Table 2.2 and Annex B Table B.1

criteria.label: Title
criteria.limitation: Title field exists; OECD reporting validation not established

criteria.label: Description of incident
criteria.limitation: Narrative exists; OECD content requirements not validated

criteria.label: AI-system relationship to incident
criteria.limitation: Involved/suspected/unknown is not OECD causal-role taxonomy

criteria.label: Submitter role/affiliation
criteria.limitation: Role exists; affiliation/contact completeness and OECD taxonomy absent

criteria.label: Date of first known occurrence
criteria.limitation: First known date recorded; OECD meaning needs verification

criteria.label: Countries of occurrence
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Supporting materials
criteria.limitation: Typed references exist; attachment/URL and provenance requirements unverified

criteria.label: AI-system name and version
criteria.limitation: System ID and optional version; OECD name/version contract absent

criteria.label: Developer/deployer organisations
criteria.limitation: Generic refs not OECD organization details

criteria.label: Severity
criteria.limitation: Free text; OECD severity scale absent

criteria.label: Harm type
criteria.limitation: Harm status/narrative, not OECD harm-type taxonomy

criteria.label: Quantification of harm
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Unintended/wrongful use linkage
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Affected stakeholders
criteria.limitation: Generic party refs, not OECD stakeholder taxonomy

criteria.label: Human/fundamental rights impacts
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Associated AI principles
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Industries
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Business functions
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Critical functions/infrastructure
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Breadth of deployment
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Training-data linkage
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Model linkage
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Usage rights
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Multiple AI-system interaction linkage
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: AI-system tasks
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Maximum autonomy level
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Actions taken
criteria.limitation: Actions represented without OECD response categories

criteria.label: Steps to reproduce
criteria.limitation: No OECD-specific field or validated equivalent in experimental draft

criteria.label: Additional information
criteria.limitation: Generic narrative is not a dedicated additional-information field
